text:
marta: Heads-up: we're pushing a "slim-quant" engine bundle tonight that changes kernel scheduling and q4a packing. Targeting night window 01:15 UTC. Low-risk but it's touching hot paths so ops eyes appreciated.

devbot: scheduled: slim-quant-bundle-v2 | start=2024-12-03T01:15:00Z | duration=00:30 | runbook=/eng-runtime/playbooks/slim-quant.md :rocket:

leo: can you summarise the compatibility matrix? which older runtimes will fallback cleanly?

marta: good Q. Fallback behaviors: a) if kernel ABI mismatch -> deploybot will route to "engine:stable-no-quant" (binary without q-* kernels); b) if perf regress only -> sticky-pin previous bundle; c) if mem OOM across >2 hosts -> immediate full rollback.

nina: what TTL for sticky pin? ops want enough time to triage but not forever.
marta: propose 3h sticky pin after rollback, with an ops override to extend in exceptional cases. Auto-unpin only if triage label "resolved" is set.

jamie: add a release-note line for Hosted customers: "Improved kernel scheduling reduces tail-latency on medium-length requests; regression window enforced. See support FAQ for Dedicated pinning." I'll draft the blurb.

opsbot: preflight: signature ok, checksum ok, telemetry-hook active, capacity-reserve 5% confirmed. Canaries available in us-west-2 and eu-central-1. :white_check_mark:

leo: metrics to watch: p50 token-rate, p95 latency, kv-cache hit% and native-ooms. Also add model-output-delta on sampling prompts (sanity).

marta: agreed. running predeploy eval (small sampling + deterministics):
```bash
./tools/eval_diff --suite=night-slim --baseline=engine:stable-no-quant --candidate=engine:slim-quant-v2 --output=artifacts/slim-night-20241203.json
```
I'll post results before launch.

nina: alert rules: fire if p95 increases >15% for 5m or kv-cache-hit drops >10% or native-ooms >= 1 host in 2m. Also a semantic-check alert if BLEU-like score drops >2% on the quickset.

jamie: what about rollout strategy? small regional canary -> staged ramp?

marta: plan: canary 1% in us-west (01:15-01:25), ramp to 10% (01:30) if green, 50% by 02:00, full by 03:00. EU will follow 1h later. If any gated alert fires during ramp, deploybot will pause and notify oncall.

devbot: safety: auto-pause threshold set. pause_if(alerts>0) during ramp. auto-fallback mode enabled (route to engine:stable-no-quant).

leo: how do customers see change? Dedicated customers should get an email note and a bundle-id in their control plane if pinned. We should include rollback play in RN doc.

jamie: drafted RN entry and appendix with pin instructions & support contact. attaching link to PR.

opsbot: small smokecheck result attached: all endpoints responded within baseline for staging (log id: smoke-20241202-2305). No OOMs in staging.

marta: excellent. one more: if we do a manual pin, let's set a short-lived label on the bundle like "hotfix-in-flight" so release ops can correlate.

nina: noted. I'll also enable verbose tracing for kv-cache misses during the first 45m.

leo: rollback steps (copyable):
1) devbot abort rollout
2) route traffic -> engine:stable-no-quant (fallback pool)
3) pin previous bundle: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood/internal/pin?bundle=engine:stable-no-quant&ttl=3h`
4) post incident note and RN update

marta: thanks. ops oncall @nina @leo please monitor first 20m and keep pager thresholds low. I'll be online for the whole window.

jamie: +1. I'll publish RN minutes after completion.

marta: ok launching preflight smoke at 01:00 UTC. will paste eval diff and smoke logs here. ping if you want to join live. :eyes:
